verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a SaaS project-management product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only public GitHub repos for API documentation, a CLI and agent skills. None of it shows Basecamp's own application source published under an open license. Those repos are adjacent developer tooling, not the product's source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
